mediabunny.min.js is dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.mjs from the npm package
mediabunny@1.65.2, unmodified (npm tarball sha1
ef1db034a70f11702dba2fbe65e8342d268dfd38). Its source code is available at
https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/v1.65.2 and in the npm package.

Only the private Studio dashboard loads it, and only when a chosen video must
be converted to fit the 25 MB publishing limit (preview_site/js/studio-video.js).
